chart.title: Labor share of gross domestic product (GDP)
chart.subtitle: The labor share of gross domestic product (GDP) is the estimated total compensation of employees given as a percent of GDP. It provides information about the relative share of output paid as compensation to employees, compared to the share paid to capital.
